# Uizard

> > Uizard is an AI-powered UI design platform that transforms text prompts, screenshots, and sketches into editable, multi-screen designs for apps, websites, and digital products.

Uizard combines artificial intelligence with intuitive design tools to democratize UI/UX design. The platform features AI-powered generators (Autodesigner 2.0, Design Assistant), intelligent scanners (Screenshot Scanner, Wireframe Scanner), and comprehensive design capabilities including wireframing, prototyping, and mockup creation across mobile, web, tablet, and desktop platforms.

## AI Design Generators

- [Uizard Autodesigner 2.0 | AI UI Design Generator](https://uizard.io/autodesigner): AI-powered Autodesigner 2.0 generates multi-screen editable designs from text prompts
- [AI UI Design | AI-Powered UI Design Is Here!](https://uizard.io/ai-design): Uizard's AI UI design platform: world's first AI-powered UI design tool
- [Uizard's AI-powered Design Assistant](https://uizard.io/design-assistant): Design Assistant: AI-powered feature for rapid mockup creation from text descriptions

## AI Conversion Tools

- [Uizard Screenshot Scanner | Screenshot Editor AI](https://uizard.io/screenshot-scanner): Screenshot Scanner: AI tool converting app screenshots into customizable mockups
- [Wireframe Scanner | Digitize Your Wireframe Sketches](https://uizard.io/wireframe-scanner): Wireframe Scanner: digitizes hand-drawn wireframes into editable digital mockups

## Core Design Tools

- [UI Design Tool | UI Design Software](https://uizard.io/ui-design): Uizard's AI-powered UI design tool with drag-and-drop editor for apps and websites
- [UX Design Tool | UX Design Software](https://uizard.io/ux-design): Uizard's UX design tool for wireframes, screenshots, and collaborative iteration
- [Online Wireframing Tool | Wireframing Software](https://uizard.io/wireframing): Uizard's wireframing tool with drag-and-drop components for mobile and web design
- [App Mockup Tool | Mockup Software](https://uizard.io/mockups): Uizard's AI-powered mockup tool for apps, webpages, and digital products
- [Prototyping Tool | Prototyping Software](https://uizard.io/prototyping): Uizard's AI-powered prototyping software for apps, websites, and digital products

## Design Templates

- [UI Templates | UI Design Templates](https://uizard.io/templates): Uizard's template library for UI design across apps, websites, and web apps

- [Web App Templates | Web App UI Templates](https://uizard.io/templates/web-app-templates): Pre-made web app UI templates for quick project setup and customization
